k1880754.notes: Yellow overhead direction sign hung on a wire across the street: right-turn arrow, white 'Ring 1' route shield, blue parking P, then 'Sentrum Ø'. A no-left-turn disc and a blue 'Taxi' sign hang beside it. A vertical black blade sign at top right ending '...akirken' is cut by the frame.

k4016832.notes: Department-store name on the curved canopy at right (clearest copy); the same name appears on the facade, on a black blade sign with 'MAGASIN' cut off, and on the windows. 'THE SALE IS HERE' banners, a VINMONOPOLET blade sign and a yellow 'FORTAU STENGT' notice are distractors. Taken through a windscreen.

k4017229.reason: regulatory traffic sign text only ('Gjelder ikke buss og taxi', 'unntatt'); no place name

p2a531896bc.notes: Black project information board for a new public pier next to the MUNCH museum building, heading set at a slight upward angle. Only the header is transcribed; the bullet list, credits (NRC Group, Rambøll, J & L Gibbons, Bymiljøetaten, Kulturetaten, Kultur- og idrettsbygg Oslo KF) and the 'ADGANG FORBUDT' site sign are distractors. Camera date stamp at lower right.

p38e5e98ac2.notes: Gold raised letters on a green shop fascia (jeweller) on a pedestrian street. A small blue 'Karl Johans gate' street plate at the corner is a distractor and too small to use; 'TOMMY 1965' on a passer-by's jacket and window text are distractors.

p696c06ee85.notes: Interpretive board by the monument; only the heading is the target. The body text (about Johan Sebastian Welhaven and sculptor Gunnar Utsond) and 'Oslo kommune' are distractors. Camera date stamp at lower right.

p6bbdc0fa87.notes: Patinated bronze plaque on a granite statue plinth; raised letters, low contrast. 'Vor Frelsers Kirke' is the old name of Oslo Cathedral and is also a possible query. Shop 'SAVE UP TO 50%' posters behind are distractors.

p9ab10b15c7.notes: Name carved in relief on a pale granite statue plinth, low contrast. Tulips in front; people in the background (one photographing) are incidental. Camera date stamp at lower right.

p9b63c56f7c.notes: School name painted in a large mural (owl and rooftops) on the gable wall, stencil-style letters; '1153' is in a lighter grey. Seen from below at an angle.

pe20e15800c.reason: war memorial plaque listing names; no place, street or business name as the target

c51806111.notes: Black fascia board over the door of a period kiosk at the Norsk Folkemuseum (open-air museum, Oslo), so the shop is a museum exhibit. Many vintage advert distractors: PLAZA så klart!, TIEDEMANNS TEDDY / ALLEMANNS VENN, DRIKK Coca-Cola (disc and sandwich board 'FRUKT / TOBAKK'), Hjemmet, SOUTH STATE, TOY tyggegummi poster, NORSK TIPPING plate and 'Åpen' door sign.

c51806112.reason: near-duplicate from the same museum kiosk as c51806111; the target is an old Norsk Tipping lottery-agent brand plate rather than the shop's name

c15339798.notes: Bergen (Gyldenpris): white enamel street plate on a whitewashed wall, slight angle. Below it a blue oval namesake plaque 'CARL KONOW / 1806 - 1876 / KJØPMANN OG STORTINGSREPRESENTANT' (distractor, small curved text).

c7986374.notes: Kirkenes: two stacked street-name plates on a pole, Norwegian above and a Cyrillic transliteration below, shot from below at an angle; Kirkenes church tower behind. Tiny 'BF 00' maker mark at the lower left of the upper plate.

c81820276.notes: Neiden: brown tourist direction sign pointing right with a museum pictogram, trilingual Norwegian / Skolt Sami (sms, ISO 639-3) / Finnish. The Skolt Sami line uses the prime letter U+02B9 (ʹ) after Ä, a and u; it looks like an acute mark on the sign. Slight blur.
